name: Discover Scuba Diving
title: Discover Scuba Diving Experience
description: Perfect introduction to scuba diving for beginners. Experience the underwater world with a certified instructor. Includes equipment, briefing, and guided dive.

name: Open Water Diver Course
title: PADI Open Water Diver Certification
description: Complete PADI Open Water Diver certification course. Learn essential scuba diving skills and earn your first diving certification. Includes theory, confined water, and open water dives.

name: Advanced Open Water Course
title: PADI Advanced Open Water Diver
description: Take your diving to the next level with the Advanced Open Water course. Includes deep diving, navigation, and three adventure dives of your choice.

name: Adventurer Course
title: PADI Advanced Adventurer
description: Fast-track advanced training program. Complete five adventure dives including deep, navigation, and three specialty dives.

name: Nitrox Diver Course
title: PADI Enriched Air (Nitrox) Diver
description: Learn to dive with enriched air nitrox for longer bottom times and shorter surface intervals. Perfect for multi-dive days.

name: Rescue Diver Course
title: PADI Rescue Diver Certification
description: Learn to prevent and manage diving emergencies. This challenging course builds confidence and develops your ability to help others.

name: Single Dive
title: Single Tank Dive
description: One guided dive to explore Seychelles' beautiful reefs and marine life. Perfect for certified divers. Includes equipment and guide.

name: Two Tank Dive
title: Two Tank Dive Package
description: Two guided dives in one day. Explore multiple dive sites and maximize your underwater adventure. Includes equipment and guide.

name: Four Dive Package
title: Four Dive Package
description: Four dives over two days. Perfect for diving enthusiasts who want to explore multiple sites. Includes equipment and guide.

name: Night Dive
title: Night Diving Experience
description: Discover the underwater world after dark. See nocturnal marine life and experience diving in a completely different environment. Includes equipment and lights.

name: Boat Charter
title: Private Boat Charter
description: Private boat charter for diving, snorkeling, or island hopping. Customize your itinerary and enjoy exclusive access to pristine dive sites.

name: Snorkeling Trip
title: Guided Snorkeling Adventure
description: Explore Seychelles' vibrant coral reefs and marine life from the surface. Perfect for non-divers. Includes equipment, guide, and boat transfer.

name: Dive Equipment Rental
title: Full Dive Equipment Rental
description: Complete scuba diving equipment rental including BCD, regulator, wetsuit, mask, fins, and weights. Perfect for certified divers traveling light.
